items.title: 9.5.1 Ka aur kamzor acid ki molar concentration se H3O+ ions ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5.1, printed pages 196-197, with Sample Problem 9.3 and Quick Check 9.3 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Weak acids pani mein poori tarah dissociate nahi hote. Is liye hydronium ions ki concentration acid ki ibtidai (initial) concentration ke barabar nahi hoti. H₃O⁺ ki concentration nikalne ke liye equilibrium expression istemal karte hain.
Weak acid HA ka pani mein dissociation aise likhte hain:
Pani mein H⁺ pani se jur kar H₃O⁺ banata hai:
Is liye H₃O⁺(aq) ke lihaz se equilibrium equation yeh hai:
Maan lein weak acid HA ki ibtidai concentration C mol dm⁻³ hai. Equilibrium par:

blocks.caption: Weak acid ka hisab ek nazar mein

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein doosre fraction ka denominator “C –” chhapa hai (x chhoot gaya); sahi C – x hai.
Weak acids mein x, C ke muqable mein bohat chhota hota hai, is liye C – x ≈ C. To expression asaan ho jati hai:

blocks.title: Sample Problem 9.3
blocks.problem: 0.1 M (mol dm⁻³) acetic acid [CH₃COOH] mein [H₃O⁺] nikalein; Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne square root ke andar 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ × 0.1 ka hasil-e-zarb 0.18 × 10⁻⁶ likha hai. Sahi 1.8 × 10⁻⁶ hai; is ka square root 1.34 × 10⁻³ M banta hai, jo kitab ka jawab bhi hai.

blocks.prompt: a) 25°C par 0.10 M formic acid (HCOOH) ka pH 2.38 hai. Formic acid ka Ka nikalein.
b) 0.1 M nitrous acid (HNO₂) mein [H₃O⁺] nikalein; Ka = 4 × 10⁻⁴.
blocks.explanation: [H₃O⁺] ≈ √(Ka × C) = √(4 × 10⁻⁴ × 0.1) = √(4 × 10⁻⁵) = 6.3 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³. (Yeh C ka taqreeban 6% hai, is liye andaza theek hai magar bilkul durust nahi.)

blocks.prompt: c) Sirke (vinegar) mein 0.837 M CH₃COOH hai aur [H₃O⁺] = 3.86 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³. Acetic acid ka Ka nikalein.
blocks.explanation: [H₃O⁺] = [CH₃COO⁻] = 3.86 × 10⁻³ aur [CH₃COOH] = 0.837 − 0.00386 = 0.833 mol dm⁻³. Ka = (3.86 × 10⁻³)² / 0.833 = 1.49 × 10⁻⁵ / 0.833 = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵. Ka 10⁻³ se kam hai, is liye acid weak hai.

items: Weak acid (concentration C): [H₃O⁺] = [A⁻] = x, [HA] = C − x, Ka = x² / (C − x) ≈ x² / C.
Sample 9.3: 0.1 M acetic acid, Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ → [H₃O⁺] = √(1.8 × 10⁻⁶) = 1.34 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³.
